$comment: Mission 2 (docs/design.md, Campaign spine): the first real bounty. A crew of three on the Embarcadero, one of them posted. Watch, then Bot Check beta, then melt; the crew converges and threat reaches 2; then escape (fog, traffic, a car wash) until threat is 0. The e2e scenario ?world=sf&scenario=spill expects a heap within 30 s of the driver's start.
title: Spill
summary: BotBounty has posted its first crew: three bad robots working the Embarcadero, one of them posted. Watch them, scan them, rust them, and get out before the rest of Moat Labs shows up.

dispatch.name: Dispatcher
dispatch.description: Polite, terse and paid per posting.

cofounder.name: Your cofounder
cofounder.description: Shipped Bot Check beta last night. It is confident.

posted.note: The posted robot: a growth hacker working the promenade.

pusher.note: Hidden: pushes the update into good robots by the ferry doors.

sniffer.note: Hidden: a Trundle by the robotaxi pickup.

crew.note: A crew of three within 60 m; one posted, two hidden.

bystander.note: Good Footmen queue at the market stalls; read before you spray.

place.label: The FiDi coworking desk, Montgomery St

lines.speaker: dispatch
lines.text: BotBounty dispatch. One posting near the Embarcadero at Mission St: a Footman, crew of three. Pays on melt.

lines.speaker: cofounder
lines.text: bot check beta is on your phone now. it's 97% confident about everything. that's a joke. it's also true

steps.note: One posted robot and two hidden ones, all within 60 m, among good robots at the market stalls.

place.label: The promenade by Mission St
place.source: Hand-placed on the promenade south of the Ferry Building

lines.speaker: dispatch
lines.text: Posted robot is in the area. Last seen near the promenade. Tell: tails a good Footman.

steps.hint: Watch first. A Watch from close up for more than 3 s makes a bad robot wary, so keep your distance.
Hold scan for one second. Bot Check is confident; it is not always right. And the ping makes nearby bad robots wary.

lines.speaker: cofounder
lines.text: if it says 98% that means nothing. if it walks like a bad robot that means something

steps.hint: Melt the posted robot. The other two will notice.
The crew knows where you are. Two melts inside a minute, or a witness, brings threat 2 and a Moat Labs van.

lines.speaker: dispatch
lines.text: Heads up: the rest of the crew is converging. A Moat Labs van has been dispatched from the depot.

steps.hint: Break line of sight: the fog, traffic, a car wash. Threat drops a level after 30 s out of sight.

lines.speaker: cofounder
lines.text: ok now LEAVE. fog, traffic, car wash, anything. they can't follow what they can't see

lines.speaker: dispatch
lines.text: Bounty confirmed. Payment sent. Revenue extends runway.

lines.speaker: cofounder
lines.text: we're profitable!!! for one afternoon!!! buy a bigger tank

lines.speaker: dispatch
lines.text: The crew has scattered. The posting will be renewed shortly.

steps.hint: Watch and scan from a distance, then commit: rust that passes 0.3 never dries off.

lines.speaker: cofounder
lines.text: they kept finding you. next time head for the fog, or the car wash on the way

lines.speaker: dispatch
lines.text: Posting expired. Another will be along. They always are.
